storyCards.headline: You Might Think: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Cars's "You Might Think" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Complete Greatest Hits" (2002) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Complete Greatest Hits (2002).

Chart story — peaked at #7 on the Hot 100.
